newsitem.title: USA: Hawaiian and Continental form alliance.
newsitem.headline: Hawaiian and Continental form alliance.

text.p: Hawaiian Airlines Inc said Thursday that it has formed a marketing alliance with Continental Airlines Inc and its Continental Micronesia affiliate to be their primary carrier among Hawaiian islands, effective October 1.
Continental will market connections throughout Hawaii on Hawaiian Airlines interisland flights and its One-Pass members can receive frequent flier miles on these flights, the airline said.

Continental Airlines currently operates two flights a day from the mainland U.S. to Honolulu from Los Angeles and San Francisco and will add a non-stop flight from Houston on Aug 1, the statement said.
